scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html --reporter=lcov --include=dist/src/**/*.js --exclude=dist/tests/** node --test dist/tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage:usecases: npm run build && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html --include=dist/src/usecases/*.js --all --check-coverage --lines 95 --functions 95 --branches 95 --statements 95 node --test dist/tests/unit/*.test.js
